verdict.rationale: Bolna explicitly documents 'Bring Your Own Telephony (BYOT)' allowing any standards-compliant SIP trunk to connect to the platform, plus IP whitelisting requirements for the connection, directly addressing carrier/PBX independence from bundled telephony. missing for 10: explicit step-by-step Twilio/Telnyx number import walkthrough and independent/hands-on verification of SIP trunk setup working end-to-end.
